space.$description: Semantic spacing. Prefer these over primitive.space.* in product code.

2xs.$description: Hairline gaps: icon-to-label inside a dense control.

xs.$description: Tight gaps inside a component (chip padding, icon + text).

sm.$description: Gaps between related controls in a group.

md.$description: Default padding inside cards and between form fields.

lg.$description: Separation between distinct groups within a section.

2xl.$description: Large page-level rhythm: hero padding, section breaks.

control.$description: Corners of interactive controls: buttons, inputs, chips. Brand-controlled.

container.$description: Corners of containers: cards, dialogs, menus. Brand-controlled.

pill.$description: Fully rounded: avatars, badges, toggle tracks.

raised.$description: Resting cards that sit just above the page.

floating.$description: Menus, popovers, dropdowns — temporary layers anchored to a trigger.

overlay.$description: Drawers and sheets that cover part of the page.

normal.$description: Default transitions: expand, fade, small moves.
